zh-CN.title: 云同步服务告知与协议草案更新
zh-CN.updatedTitle: 协议已修改，请仔细阅读
zh-CN.updatedDescription: 云同步服务告知与协议草案已修改，请仔细阅读。继续同步前需要重新确认，旧版本的确认不会自动沿用。
zh-CN.intro: 请了解将同步哪些资料、密码与认证如何处理，以及关闭和删除的区别。同步包含服务 API Key 和私密文本历史；请在继续前阅读以下内容。

sections.title: 由个人开发者免费提供
sections.body: 云同步由 OpenLess 个人开发者提供，面向全球用户，由开发者及赞助商共同免费支持。OpenLess 不收取本同步服务费用，服务器赞助商为 Mivra（悠雾云数据）。您自行使用的网络及第三方模型、转写等服务可能另行收费。

sections.title: 范围包含 API Key、文本历史和设备档案
sections.body: 加密快照包含登记的应用与界面偏好、服务渠道和 API Key 等凭据、词典与词汇预设、纠正规则、风格内容和适用图标、文本历史、每日活动次数／字符数／时长，以及设备档案。设备档案包含设备标识、系统、架构、应用版本和需保留或复查的设备设置、路径、渠道及窗口位置。当前不提供逐类排除 API Key 或历史的选项；不希望同步这些内容时，请暂不开启。

sections.title: 录音文件和登录凭据不进入备份
sections.body: 快照不包含录音文件、模型权重、缓存、程序或系统凭据库文件，也不包含同步密码、解密密钥、OpenLess 管理的 GitHub／OAuth 登录态及令牌、同步令牌、设备私钥、远程输入 PIN 或系统权限授权。光标上下文开关可同步，实际光标文本不进入同步文档。恢复其他设备档案不会自动执行其中路径、授予权限或启动 Agent。

sections.title: 在本机加密，并妥善保存密码
sections.body: 快照内容在本机加密后通过 HTTPS 传输；同步密码和派生密钥不发送给同步服务器。密码在本机按 NFC 规范化，当前要求 12–128 个字符并含 ASCII 大写、小写和数字，创建或改密还会检查常见弱密码。“记住密钥”依赖本设备系统安全存储。我们无法找回原密码，当前改密仍要求旧密码；已解锁设备不等于可无旧密码重置。没有密码也没有可取得的本地资料时，云端内容可能永久无法读取。加密不能保证设备失陷或软件漏洞下绝对安全。

sections.title: 认证和必要元数据仍需处理
sections.body: 登录凭据不进入备份，但官方同步认证会将 GitHub 访问令牌单独发送给同步服务以换取短期会话。服务端能处理账号标识、登录名、vault／key／操作标识、版本、操作类型、密文大小与摘要、加密参数及同步时间等协议资料。自定义服务器使用其实际认证安排。Mivra 赞助不表示其可获得解密密钥；实际基础设施法律实体、部署地区、日志和处理安排仍须核实，不能把密文一概视为匿名资料。

sections.title: 确认告知与同步完成是不同步骤
sections.body: 同步需要启用、认证可用且设备已解锁。已有云端快照首次接入前需要验证和恢复预览；日常可合并变更可能自动应用，冲突需要复查。打开开关、确认告知或点击按钮不表示上传已经完成。“结果未知”时应先核对原操作；取消不能撤回已经发到服务器的请求，恢复事务可能仍须完成提交或回滚。

sections.title: 关闭、退出和删除各有不同作用
sections.body: 关闭、锁定或退出不删除云端快照，删除云端备份需要另行确认。确认删除当前快照后，本机资料保留，离线设备的本机副本不会被远程擦除。官方公开能力接口在本次核对时声明服务备份副本最多保留 7 天；这不是所有账号、日志、收据或删除标记同时清除的保证，也不代表可以选择任意历史版本恢复。实际备份清理机制和其他保留期限仍须运营核实。

zh-CN.draftBoundary: 这是当前开发版的云同步事实告知与协议草案更新。服务提供者的完整身份和联系渠道、基础设施处理安排及完整法律条款仍待确认与法律审查；本页不替代最终服务协议，也不承诺绝对安全或永久可用。免费和赞助不免除提供者依法应承担的责任。
zh-CN.checkbox: 我已阅读以上更新告知，了解同步包含服务凭据与私密文本、密码丢失及删除边界，并同意按本页说明进行加密同步。
zh-CN.cancelHint: 暂不同意不会记录本次确认；在重新确认前，本设备暂停后续同步。已经发出的请求仍可能完成。

en.title: Cloud sync disclosure and draft agreement update
en.updatedTitle: The cloud sync disclosure has changed
en.updatedDescription: The cloud sync disclosure and draft agreement have changed. Please read them carefully and confirm again before continuing. Your previous confirmation will not carry over automatically.
en.intro: Review the data included, how passwords and authentication work, and the difference between turning sync off and deleting a backup. Sync includes service API keys and private text history.

sections.title: Provided free by an individual developer
sections.body: OpenLess cloud sync is provided by an individual developer for users worldwide, with free support from the developer and sponsors. OpenLess charges no fee for this sync service. The server sponsor is Mivra, also branded 悠雾云数据. Your network provider and separately configured model, transcription or other services may charge their own fees.

sections.title: Includes API keys, text history and device profiles
sections.body: Encrypted snapshots include registered app and interface preferences, service channels and credentials such as API keys, dictionaries and vocabulary presets, correction rules, style content and applicable icons, text history, daily activity counts, character counts and duration, and device profiles. Profiles include device identifiers, OS, architecture, app version and device settings, paths, channels and window positions to retain or review. This flow does not offer category exclusions for API keys or history. Leave sync off if you do not want these included.

sections.title: Audio files and sign-in credentials are excluded from the backup
sections.body: Snapshots exclude audio files, model weights, caches, programs and system credential-store files. They also exclude your sync password, decryption keys, OpenLess-managed GitHub/OAuth sign-in state and tokens, sync tokens, device private keys, remote-input PINs and system permission grants. The cursor-context switch can sync; actual cursor text is not included in sync documents. Restoring another device's profile does not execute its paths, grant permissions or start an Agent.

sections.title: Encrypt locally and keep your password safe
sections.body: Snapshot content is encrypted locally before HTTPS transfer. The sync password and derived key are not sent to the sync server. Passwords are normalized locally to NFC. The current policy requires 12–128 characters with ASCII uppercase, lowercase and a digit; creating or changing a password also checks common weak patterns. Remembering the key relies on this device's secure storage. We cannot recover the original password, and changing it still requires the old password. An unlocked device does not provide a password-free reset. Without the password or accessible local data, cloud content may become permanently unreadable. Encryption cannot guarantee safety against a compromised device or software vulnerabilities.

sections.title: Authentication and necessary metadata are handled separately
sections.body: Sign-in credentials are excluded from snapshots, but official sync authentication separately sends a GitHub access token to the sync service for a short-lived session. The server handles protocol information including account identifiers, login, vault/key/operation identifiers, versions, operation types, ciphertext size and digest, encryption parameters and sync times. Custom servers use their actual authentication arrangements. Mivra sponsorship does not mean it receives decryption keys. Infrastructure legal entities, locations, logs and processing arrangements still require verification; ciphertext must not automatically be treated as anonymous data.

sections.title: Confirmation and completed sync are different steps
sections.body: Sync requires it to be enabled, authentication to be available and this device to be unlocked. Connecting to an existing snapshot for the first time requires verification and a restore preview. Routine changes that can be merged may apply automatically; conflicts need review. Turning on the switch, confirming this disclosure or clicking a button does not prove an upload completed. An unknown outcome requires checking the original operation. Cancellation cannot recall a request already sent, and a restore transaction may still need to commit or roll back.

sections.title: Turning off, signing out and deleting have different effects
sections.body: Turning sync off, locking or signing out does not delete the cloud snapshot. Deletion requires separate confirmation and keeps local data; it does not remotely erase an offline device's local copy. At this review, the official public capability endpoint declared a maximum of seven days for service backup copies. This does not guarantee simultaneous deletion of all account information, logs, receipts or deletion markers, or provide selectable historical restores. Actual backup cleanup and other retention periods still require operational verification.

en.draftBoundary: This is the current development build's factual sync disclosure and draft agreement update. The provider's complete identity and contact channels, infrastructure processing arrangements and full legal terms still require confirmation and legal review. This page does not replace a final service agreement or promise absolute security or permanent availability. Free service and sponsorship do not remove the provider's responsibilities under applicable law.
